on_actions = {
	# Tokyo Express: elect each sea region's anchor state (the single map-icon
	# holder). The effect is auto-generated by _modtools/Generate-TokyoExpressRegions.py
	# and idempotent (flags are cleared first), so re-running is always safe.
	#
	# Numeric state scopes inside a scripted effect do NOT resolve from the scopeless
	# on_startup context (proven 2026-07-15), hence the JAP country-scope dive.
	# Controllers are not final yet during on_startup either, so the startup election
	# can come up empty on a fresh 1936 start - the daily re-election below fixes the
	# map by January 2nd.
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			JAP = {
				JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Anchors follow the front line: re-elect daily so a state captured or lost
	# moves the region's map icon to the best held coastal state.
	on_daily_JAP = {
		effect = {
			JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
